_comment: Controller guides UI (2026-11-23): the player's photos in qt/assets/controller_guides/photos and, per controller, where the buttons are on that photo (pixels of the cropped photo): controls {x, y, r}; callouts {text, x, y, to: [x, y]} for triggers that the front view hides. items: which controls each numbered line lights up. Texts: en/pt.

subtitle.en: Graffiti, absorbing powers, doors and the scanner
subtitle.pt: Grafite, absorver poderes, portas e scanner

footer.en: Your controller has no gyro or touchpad: the port simulates both.
footer.pt: Seu controle não tem giroscópio nem touchpad: o port simula os dois.

details.en: Click L3 + R3 (both sticks) or the Share button (Xbox Series)
details.pt: Clique L3 + R3 (os dois analógicos) ou o botão Compartilhar (Xbox Series)

details.en: View button (the two squares). Hold = hold the touchpad (absorb a power)
details.pt: Botão View (os dois quadrados). Segurar = segurar o touchpad (absorver poder)

details.en: Hold the View button and move the right stick in the asked direction ('Open Door')
details.pt: Segure o botão View e mova o analógico direito na direção pedida (porta 'Open Door')

details.en: Hold the View button and press RB (lift the car off Reggie)
details.pt: Segure o botão View e aperte RB (levantar o carro de cima do Reggie)
